title: WNBA PRA Repair V1 Step 3 — Page 3 Data Completeness
scope: Page-3 presentation/data handoff repair above frozen WNBA PRA Speed V3 Step 9. Preserve L5/L10 form and usage fields from the frozen role row, derive opponent identity from selected-game truth rather than the consumer Top-5, use existing PRA V3.6 pace context, and retain exact history/H2H when available. No final-card forcing in Step 3.
root_causes: Page 3 derived opponent_team_key only from an exact qualified consumer card. When the Step-18 consumer was unavailable/stale or the selected player was not on the qualified board, opponent identity became N/A even though the selected game already proved the opponent.
The frozen Game Center role row already contains L5/L10 production and usage fields, but _record_from_role_row drops them before the selected-player snapshot reaches Page 3.
The frozen Page-3 renderer hardcodes pace and usage as N/A instead of exposing already-established WNBA PRA context/role evidence.
History/H2H lookup received a null opponent key whenever consumer qualification was absent, so same-opponent history could not match even when player game-log history was present.
patch: Add a reversible runtime overlay above frozen Speed V3 Step 9. Preserve role-row L5/L10 and usage evidence, derive canonical opponent identity from selected game + player team, backfill recent aggregates only from the verified role row when per-game history is absent, reuse PRA V3.6 matchup_factors_v36 for pace display, and transparently label a display-only production-role proxy only when verified usage is unavailable.
